author: LGR
description:
Revisiting when DVD movies came with DVD-ROM extras accessible on a PC in the late 90s and early 2000s! I kinda forgot InterActual Player and PC Friendly discs were a thing til a couple years ago, but they're a fun bonus feature to explore whenever I find a movie including them. So let's dive into their history and try a bunch out on an old PC!
